Ac-38
AIR CONDITIONING - COMPRESSOR ANO MAGNETIC CLUTCH
DISASSEMBLY
1. REMOVE PRESSURE PLATE
(a} Using SST and a socket wrench, remove the shaft bolt.
SST 07112-76060
Torque: 13.2 N,m (135 kgf-cm, 9 tt-lbf)
AC0943
(b) Install SST on the pressure plate.
SST SST 07112--66040
AC0\144
(c) Using SST and socket wrench, remove the pressure
plate.
SST 07112--66040, 07112-76060
AC0'./45
(d) Remove the shims from the pressure plate.
AC0\146
2. REMOVE ROTOR
(a) Using SST, remove the snap ring.
SST 07114-84020
